name: Motor local-off-auto authority block
summary: Selects the permitted motor command origin according to the local selector position.
description: Selects the permitted motor command origin according to the local selector position. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Selector and command sources” at the input and “Accepted motor command” at the output. Off selection is not an electrical isolation device.
